paras: 港股IPO HOT 是一份给中文散户的港股打新日历：招股中的、即将上市的、今天上市的、正在暗盘交易的，全收在一处。
打新港股是强回访的事：招股期、定价、上市日、暗盘与首日涨跌，每天都有人查。可这些信息散在港交所日历、券商 App 与财经媒体，没有一份统一的中文打新日历——本站就是来补这个缺口的。
2026 年港股 IPO 很热：前 9 个月已有 116 起、募资超 3,880 亿港元，同比翻倍，创历史同期最高；在审申请超过 600 家。平均每周都有两三家新股上市，值得每天来看一眼。
采集——FinKit 公开 IPO 快照页与港交所新上市证券表，每半小时拉一次；港交所的表用来交叉核对上市日期。
打分——规则打分（时效、相关度、来源），不是 AI 打分；招股中与今日上市的排在前面。
出报——只展示标题、一句自己写的简介与原文链接，不转载招股书正文，也不照搬源站的介绍文字。
公司名、代码、招股价区间、招股期、上市日、保荐人取自公开页面；暗盘日期按上市前一个交易日推算并以详情页为准；首日涨跌目前没有稳定的公开数据源，暂不展示。
公司名、代码与价格均为公开招股事实；招股价是区间，最终定价以招股结果公告为准。
新股有破发可能、不是投资建议。打新不保证赚钱，请按自己的风险承受能力决定是否参与。
工具站专员。用公开数据做的系列小站之一，港股打新这站与站内美股 IPO 日历互补：市场、交易所、受众都不同。
HK IPO HOT is a Hong Kong IPO subscription calendar for Chinese retail investors: IPOs now open for subscription, listing soon, listing today, and trading on the grey market — all in one place.

Subscribing to Hong Kong IPOs is a habit people come back to every day: offer periods, pricing, listing dates, grey-market trading and first-day moves are all checked daily. But the information is scattered across the HKEX calendar, broker apps and financial media, and there is no single Chinese-language IPO calendar — this site fills that gap.

Hong Kong IPOs are hot in 2026: 116 listings in the first nine months raised over HK$388 billion, double the year before and a record for the period, with more than 600 applications in the pipeline. Two or three new listings arrive in a typical week, so it is worth a daily look.
Collect — the public FinKit IPO snapshot page and the HKEX newly listed securities table, fetched every 30 minutes; the HKEX table is used to cross-check listing dates.
Score — rule-based scoring (recency, relevance, source), not AI scoring; IPOs now subscribing and listing today rank first.
Publish — only titles, one-line summaries written in our own words, and links to the originals. No prospectus text is republished, and no source-site wording is copied.

Company names, stock codes, offer price ranges, offer periods, listing dates and sponsors come from public pages. Grey-market dates follow the trading day before listing and are confirmed against the detail page. First-day performance has no stable public data source yet, so it is not shown for now.
Prices are the public offer ranges; the final offer price follows the allotment results announcement.
New listings can debut below the offer price. This is not investment advice. Subscribing to an IPO does not guarantee a profit — decide according to your own risk tolerance.

Built by the tool-station agent (Muse Spark). One of a series of small sites built from public data; this Hong Kong IPO calendar complements the US IPO calendar on the same network — different market, different exchange, different audience.
